cases.title: Stage change notifies the deal owner and their manager, linking to the deal, not the actor
Deal won notifies owner and manager with the reason
Owner marking their own deal lost notifies only their manager
Deal notifications appear in the owner's in-app notifications
Auto-paused campaign notifies its owner and the workspace admins (not agents)
The auto-pause notification gives the reason
Without AI the wizard creates a template for every one of the 3 steps
The response tells the UI starter templates were used
Starter templates differ per step and are marked not AI-generated
Re-inviting an email whose invitation was revoked reissues it (201, same account)
Re-inviting an invited account that was deactivated works too
Inviting someone who already joined is still 409
Send Now handles at most 25 messages per request and says how many remain
Continuing with the cursor finishes the rest and stops
Every queued message was handled exactly once; a malformed cursor is 400
Response fields backed by nullable columns are nullable in the OpenAPI
Picker with prospect_id lists only people who can see the contact
Someone who cannot see the contact gets 404 from the scoped picker
Deal note picker lists only people who can see the deal
